channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Reminiscing about Kirby Puckett 20 years after his death
item.description: Two longtime baseball writers and Minnesota Star Tribune columnists share their fondest memories of perhaps the most popular athlete in Minnesota history.

item.title: Vikings restructure contracts of three top players to clear cap space ahead of free agency
item.description: The Vikings, needing to cut more than $40 million before March 11, reworked the deals of Justin Jefferson, Christian Darrisaw and Byron Murphy Jr.

item.title: Spanish Revival home from Minneapolis architect Ella Pendergast lists for $1.475M
item.description: The 100-year-old, 4,355-square-foot house is on historic Kings Highway near Lake Harriet.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild use three-goal outburst in second period to sink Golden Knights 4-2
item.description: Michael McCarron had a goal and an assist in his debut as the Wild completed a season sweep of Vegas.

item.title: Reusse: Wins by Warroad and Hibbing/Chisholm set up all-North final
item.description: Warroad’s win over Delano was the first upset of the boys hockey state tournament, but it was a mild one.

item.title: St. Paul hotels, closed amid ICE operation, have reopened. Nearby businesses are still recovering.
item.description: The Hilton DoubleTree and IHG Continental cited safety concerns when closing in January amid reports they housed federal agents.

item.title: Trump attending Saturday’s dignified transfer of Nicole Amor, other troops killed in Kuwait
item.description: Amor, who lived in White Bear Lake, was killed in an Iranian attack on a U.S. base in Kuwait on Sunday.

item.title: Skepticism in Minnesota that new DHS leadership will ‘fix a broken system’
item.description: Activists in Minnesota, feeling bruised by the federal immigration surge, aren’t sure much will change under a new leader at Homeland Security.
